_why: RECORDED FIXTURES for tooling/release/test/submitters.contract.test.mjs: one good listing record and one artifact per store channel that has a code submitter (tooling/ports/channels.json). The values are shaped like the real trees (apps/{app}/store/<channel>, extensions/Extension/{tool}/store/<store>) and are not read from them, so a dry run here depends on no file outside this one and the register.
A binary field (a .png) is a placeholder string: validate() grades presence, never pixels — the pixel checks are assert-store-metadata.mjs's and check-store-metadata.mjs's.

The contract test removes each REQUIRED field in turn (the register's storeMetadataContract, or contracts/store/vocabulary.js for an extension row) and requires validate() to name it, so a field added to the contract without one here reddens the good-record limb first.
